name: std::localtime
intro: Converts given time since epoch as std::time_t value into calendar time, expressed in local time.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
time

 -

 pointer to a std::time_t object to convert

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Pointer to a static internal std::tm object on success, or null pointer otherwise. The structure may be shared between std::gmtime, std::localtime, and std::ctime, and may be overwritten on each invocation.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text:
This function may not be thread-safe.

POSIX requires that this function sets errno to EOVERFLOW if it fails because the argument is too large.

POSIX specifies that the timezone information is determined by this function as if by calling tzset, which reads the environment variable TZ.

examples.output:
UTC:   Sat Feb 15 18:15:00 2020 GMT
local: Sat Feb 15 10:15:00 2020 PST
